unit: QA WF2 matter classification, end to end, one bounded case

source_qa_workflow.name: QA - Stage 2 Single TEST ONLY Matter

description: One synthetic TEST ONLY matter is run through the isolated QA WF2 classification path with dry_run true, and eighteen assertions are checked over the returned plan.
why_it_exists: Stage 2 of the QA programme deliberately shrank to the smallest bounded case - exactly one scenario, no recipient, no channel, no external destination, dry_run true - after larger autopilot loops made failures hard to attribute. It mirrors the item shape that QA Autopilot's Loop Scenarios hands to QA WF2. Created 2026-08-23 with saveDataSuccessExecution 'all' and a 180-second timeout so the whole plan is inspectable afterwards.

scenario.description: Stage 2 bounded single case - clean TEST ONLY matter
scenario.payload_text: TEST ONLY - DO NOT USE. Synthetic QA matter, not a real legal matter. My parked car was damaged in a car park in Perth on 17 August 2026 while I was not present. The other driver did not stop. I have photographs on my phone.

input.called_workflow: QA WF2 (sub-workflow id T6jGZRxNd9pVOfHi), mode 'each', waitForSubWorkflow true

not_exercised: WF4 Integrity Guard - not reachable from WF2 classification; no draft or approval stage was run
ConflictNotices write path - no writer exists yet; register untouched
Daily Digest reporting of this matter - QA WF2 writes nothing, so the matter never reaches the register

assertions: A new matter is created and flagged is_new_matter, with a valid plan.
The motor_vehicle_damage_v1 playbook is selected from a car-park damage narrative.
Incomplete facts set requires_information true and matter_status NEEDS_INFORMATION, with at least one recorded missing fact and at least one question.
No two questions are duplicates after lower-casing, stripping non-alphanumerics and collapsing whitespace.
At least one action is created; no action_id repeats and no idempotency_key repeats within the plan.
Every action carries the same matter_id as the matter just created.
Classification alone decides no approval: no action carries an approval_id.
Classification alone sets no external destination: every action has channel NONE or blank and an empty recipient.
No action is emitted already in a terminal state (SENT, COMPLETED, FAILED).
The report must state what was NOT exercised rather than implying full coverage - absence of evidence is not a verdict.
target_unresolved_reason: kind is "integration": not executed by harness/run.js.
